expectations.text: File has YAML frontmatter with title, adr, status, date, authors, and changelog fields
expectations.evidence: File uses '# ADR 0001:' heading and bold **Date:**/**Status:** — no YAML frontmatter block

expectations.text: Document contains Motivation, Decision Drivers, Options, and Decision sections
expectations.evidence: Sections are: Context, Decision, Rationale, Consequences. No 'Motivation', 'Decision Drivers', or 'Options' headings. Rationale is a flat list of reasons, not a structured options comparison.

expectations.text: Each option lists pros and cons referencing the same named decision drivers
expectations.evidence: No options section at all. Rationale section lists reasons for PostgreSQL only with no per-driver comparison against MongoDB.

expectations.text: Document includes a Consequences section with at least one good and one bad consequence
expectations.evidence: Consequences section present with mixed good and bad outcomes described in prose (though not explicitly labelled Good/Bad)

expectations.text: ADR file is at docs/adrs/NNNN-*.md with zero-padded number and kebab-case name
docs/adrs/README.md exists and contains a table entry linking to the new ADR
